narrative:
## CFO Submission — FY2026 Rare Disease Plan

The FY2026 Rare Disease plan of USD 8.35B was built in a 6-phase collaborative process across Finance, Patient Insights, Brand, Market Access and Revenue Management.

## Key Themes
• Ultomiris: USD 5.03B, with Neurology (gMG, NMOSD) the fastest-growing therapy area
• Strensiq HPP: USD 1.35B, supported by adult diagnosis
• Soliris: managed decline to USD 1.02B through conversion and biosimilar entry

## Risk Factors
• European biosimilar tenders and JCA price pressure
• US GTN mix (Medicaid, 340B)

## AI/ML Governance
• 3 AI agents produced 14 proposals across 5 phases
• Intelligence consumed: 10 documents from 5 source types
• Forecast models within tolerance (feature-enhanced MAPE 6.4%)
